description: Given a user's GPA and test score, calculate match category (Safety/Target/Reach/Far Reach), admission probability, and percentiles for one school or a ranked list. Public — no authentication required.

atar.description: Australian Tertiary Admission Rank (0-99.95). Used instead of test_score/gpa for Australian schools, which select on a published ATAR cutoff.

gpa.description: Cumulative GPA on a 4.0 scale (omit for ATAR-based Australian schools)

limit.description: Number of top schools to return when no school_slug given

school_slug.description: If provided, calculate for this school only. Otherwise returns a ranked list.

test_score.description: Test score: LSAT 120-180, MCAT 472-528, DAT 200-600 (the scale since March 2025; the retired 1-30 scale is also accepted), OAT 200-400, GMAT/GRE for MBA. Omit for pharmacy (PCAT retired 2024 — GPA-only) and for ATAR-based Australian schools.

work_experience_years.description: Years of full-time work experience (MBA programs only)

name: calculate_match_score
title: Calculate match score
